A studio with
a direct line.

Digits Studio is led by Ahmad Alawieh in Beirut. You work directly with the person shaping your project, from the first conversation through the handover.

The approach is simple: understand the business, make the work clear, and build something you can actually use. In English, Arabic or both.

A clear path
from here.

No mystery around what happens next. We agree on the scope, review the work together and prepare a practical handover.

  1. 1

    Find the direction

    Your business, your audience and the problem we need to solve. Then a clear scope and quote.

  2. 2

    Make it together

    Design, build and focused feedback at agreed milestones. You see the work as it takes shape.

  3. 3

    Put it out there

    Final checks, usable files and a handover. Ongoing support can be scoped when you need it.

A few things
you might ask.

Can we work together outside Lebanon?+

Yes. Projects can run remotely, with agreed meeting times, shared feedback and a clear handover. We will confirm the scope and working arrangements before starting.

Do you work in Arabic and English?+

Yes. Both languages are considered in the layout and content structure. Translation and copywriting requirements are agreed as part of the project.

How much does a project cost?+

It depends on what needs to be made, the content and the level of support. Share your brief and budget range; Ahmad will put together a scope and quote before work starts.

Can I start with just one service?+

Of course. Start with an identity, a website or a focused marketing brief. We can define a larger rollout when you need it.

What’s your
next move?

A new business, a fresh identity or a website that needs to do more. Tell Ahmad where you are and where you want to go.
